Computes listed pharmacies per 10,000 residents for every Montgomery tract using a left join so zero-count tracts are retained, then ranks ascending with null rates last.
sql:
WITH pharmacy_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, SUM(n) AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_527232' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
population AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_527232_m2_cdc
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    t.name,
    COALESCE(pc.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
    pop.totalpopulation,
    CASE WHEN pop.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND pop.totalpopulation > 0
         THEN (COALESCE(pc.pharmacy_count, 0) / pop.totalpopulation) * 10000
    END AS pharmacies_per_10000_totalpopulation,
    t.geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN pharmacy_counts pc ON t.geoid = pc.geoid
  LEFT JOIN population pop ON t.geoid = pop.geoid
  WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name, pharmacies_per_10000_totalpopulation, pharmacy_count, totalpopulation, geoid
FROM combined
ORDER BY pharmacies_per_10000_totalpopulation ASC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
